anomalies.observed: The LD39200 output is on +3.3V, but neither MCU VDD pin appears on +3.3V or +3V3; every FCC1 and NAVC1 VDD pin is in an unconnected net. The +3V3 net also contains MCU VBAT, pull-ups, and connectors but no regulator output. FCC1/NAVC1 NRST and BOOT0 pins are likewise unconnected even though reset/boot nets exist.
anomalies.expected: The 3V3 rail from the LDO should feed both MCU VDD pins and the associated pull-up/connector rail, and MCU NRST/BOOT0 should connect to the reset and boot-select circuitry.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: Both MCUs are unpowered and cannot be reset or boot-selected; the board cannot operate.

anomalies.observed: FCC1 HSE1 is connected to PE6/PE7 (pins 5/37), while FCC1 PH0/PH1 are tied only to capacitors/VREF-related nets. For NAVC1, HSE2 nets contain only the crystal and passive parts and no NAVC1 oscillator pins; NAVC1 PH0/PH1 are tied to GND capacitors.
anomalies.expected: The HSE crystal should connect to the MCU oscillator pins PH0/PH1 on both STM32H753 and STM32F405.
anomalies.impact: The external high-speed clock is applied to the wrong FCC pins and is not connected to the NAVC at all, preventing normal MCU clocking/boot.

anomalies.observed: FCC1 pin 48, named VCAP and typed power_out, is connected to UART3_TX_FCC, and FCC1 pin 73, also VCAP/power_out, is connected to UART3_RX_FCC.
anomalies.expected: STM32H753 VCAP pins must be bypassed to GND with capacitors and cannot be used as UART signal pins.
anomalies.impact: Internal core-supply filter pins are merged with external UART lines, likely preventing power-up and risking damage.
